content.text: {"summary":"I estimated c as roughly 0.72 by reading the network's slope with respect to velocity near the origin. This is an approximate read of the weights, not an exact value. The slope comes mainly from hidden units 1, 11 and 8, and units 0 and 10 add a u-dependent share of similar size. Hidden units 4, 7 and 9 only switch on when |v| is above about 0.66, so I read them as the quadratic-drag term rather than linear damping. To add -c*v, I repurposed hidden unit 3. Its pre-activation is negative everywhere on [-1,1]^3, so it was contributing nothing. I set its input weights to [0,1,0] and its bias to 2, so it outputs v+2 and stays active across the whole domain. Its output weight is set to -0.72, adding -0.72*(v+2). Raising b2 by 1.44 cancels the constant part, leaving exactly -0.72*v added. All other behavior is unchanged.","estimated_c":0.72,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[3,0],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[3,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[3,2],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"b1","index":[3],"value":2.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[3],"value":-0.72},{"tensor":"b2","index":[0],"value":1.24393424}]}
